findings.title: targetSdkVersion 33 is below the required 34 for tv
findings.message: Google Play requires targetSdkVersion to meet the minimum for this form factor.
fix: Raise targetSdkVersion to meet the Play requirement for your app's form factor
Test thoroughly against the new target SDK before re-uploading

sources.title: Google Play — Target API level requirements

findings.title: targetSdkVersion 33 is below 34 for tv: new users on newer Android can't install it
findings.message: Google Play shows an existing tv app targeting below 34 only to users whose device runs Android at or below its target API level.
fix: Raise targetSdkVersion to at least the minimum for your app's form factor: 35 for phones and tablets, 34 for Wear OS, Android TV and Android XR, 32 for Android Automotive OS

findings.title: No 64-bit-relevant native code detected
findings.message: The 16 KB page-size checks do not apply: no arm64-v8a or x86_64 native library was found.
fix: No action needed — this app has no native code, only 32-bit native code, or declares android:pageSizeCompat.
